Vegetables & Fruits
Tender Form showing approximate required quantity along with the terms and conditions can be procured from the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba  Hospital,  Sewagram  at a  cost of  Rs.100/- during  4
th
November, 2022 to 18
th
November, 2022 in working hours on all working days. Suppliers / Vendors must ensure that each paper of the Tender Form is duly signed by them before the submission of Tender form.  The  last date for  submission of the  Tender  Form  is
18
th
November, 2022 up to 05:00 PM

Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
paragraphs: Sealed Tenders are called by registered post addressed to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram for a period of Six Month. (1 st December, 2022 to 31 st May, 2023) for the following items.

Tender Form showing approximate required quantity along with the terms and conditions can be procured from the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram at a cost of Rs.100/- during 4 th November, 2022 to 18 th November, 2022 in working hours on all working days. Earnest money of Rs. 1000/- toward Vegetables & Fruits paid through Bank Demand Draft / Pay Order drawn in favour of Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, should accompany with the Tender Form. Suppliers / Vendors must ensure that each paper of the Tender Form is duly signed by them before the submission of Tender form. The last date for submission of the Tender Form is 18 th November, 2022 up to 05:00 PM. Received Tenders will be opened in the Committee Room of Dean Office on 19 th November, 2022 at 12:00 Noon.

The Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, reserves the rights to reject any or all the Tenders without assigning any reason. If by any reason the last date of the submission / opening of the Tender is on holiday, the next working day will be treated as the last date.
